items.prompt: White to move. Find a strong move. Theme: development. Are your rooks connected yet?

claims.statement: The engine's best move (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16) is O-O-O; the accepted moves O-O-O and d4 are within 30 cp of it.
Before the move White's rooks are not connected.
After O-O-O White's rooks are connected.

hints: List your pieces and ask which one has the worst job, or which feature of the position you could use.
Which of your pieces stands between your rooks, and where can it go?
A king makes the move.
items.explain: Engine evidence (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16, one thread): O-O-O is the top choice; d4 is within 30 cp of it. O-O-O connects White's rooks: afterwards they stand on one rank or file with nothing between them. Rule of thumb, not proved by the engine: connected rooks defend each other and can use the same file together; connecting them is often the last step of development.
